predecessors.name: Federal Republic of Germany (West Germany)
predecessors.text: West Germany, of which reunified Germany is 'an enlarged continuation'

predecessors.name: German Democratic Republic
predecessors.text: the five re-established East German states (Brandenburg, Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania, Saxony, Saxony-Anhalt, Thuringia) and East Berlin, which joined West Berlin

ledger.x: 1990-10-03: the German Democratic Republic accedes to the Federal Republic.

certainty.note: The eastern frontier is the Oder-Neisse line, confirmed by the German-Polish border treaty signed on 14 November 1990 and in force on 16 January 1992; the other frontiers are inherited West German ones.
